veranderings.blok: Nog 'n manier om papier sterk te maak
veranderings.na: Jy verander net die papier se vorm
veranderings.rede: Directly after a sentence about the tube, 'sy' could read as the tube's shape; naming the paper makes the reference clear.

veranderings.voor: Druk net die heel punt van 'n stut
veranderings.na: Druk net die uiterste punt van 'n stut
veranderings.rede: 'Heel' does not combine with a bare noun like 'punt'; 'die uiterste punt' is the natural way to say the very tip.
